# skillerie

> skillerie is a CLI that turns one git repository of coding-agent skills, agents, rules, instructions and MCP servers into native configuration for OpenCode, Codex, OMO and Pi, and installs it into each harness home.

Install and run it with `npx skillerie`. Skills are written once in a shared Markdown dialect and translated per harness; skills can also be loaded from GitHub with `skills.external`. Installs are reversible: replaced files are backed up and `skillerie uninstall` restores them. Requires Node 22+ on macOS or Linux.

## Docs

- [Agent setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/e-n-0/skillerie/main/docs/agent-setup.md): step-by-step setup and migration for coding agents
- [Configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/e-n-0/skillerie/main/docs/config.md): every skillerie.yaml key, external skills, mcp.json
- [Authoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/e-n-0/skillerie/main/docs/authoring.md): skill and agent frontmatter, the dialect, per-harness translation
- [Install, status and uninstall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/e-n-0/skillerie/main/docs/install.md): commands, flags, exit codes, safety model
